Fable's review of muse-wonder-full-1.0

"The other agent was capable—landing fifteen solid PRs with clean mechanisms and no mission violations—but made three process slips (ran a full battery on a docs-only PR, left handoff.md stale, and filed rather than fixed several follow-up bugs)"

My summary:  Muse slipped on some procedures, but mainly wrote good code and lots of it.  15 PRs in one day.  (codex gets 2-3, and Fable gets 6-8)

note_tweet.text:
Congrats to MSL! This week, we introduced Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full 😊

These are our most capable models — they can remember important details, try different approaches when something isn't working, and stick with a task even when things don't go as planned. A big step towards more personal superintelligence.

Muse Wonder is available now through the Meta Model API and Muse Code, while Muse Wonder Full is available to Muse Code subscribers. And soon, Muse Wonder will power experiences in Muse, rolling out first to subscribers.

More on what we launched here: https://t.co/l7rigNJVJ8

Used Muse to switch my electricity & gas providers this morning.

I gave it my bills, it used a browser to look through various options, then it read through all the T&Cs and filled in the forms.

Probably should have done this a while ago, but it's a much nicer experience with an agent doing it for you!
